topic: 教育话题与段落论证 · Independent new scenario: a small research project choosing a method
grammarFocus: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Choosing a Research Method: A Small Project Meeting
instructions: 本材料为模拟教育练习，不是官方雅思考试，也不代表任何分数。先听/读对话，理解大意；再完成10道题（单选、填空、判断）。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。语法部分先看中文讲解，再完成8道新句练习。最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, everyone. Thanks for coming to our project meeting. We need to choose a method for our small research project on student study habits. Let's start with ideas.

Leo: I think we should use a questionnaire. It's fast, and we can get many answers. Because of the large number of students, a questionnaire is practical. It allows us to collect data from many people in a short time.

Mia: That's true. Although a questionnaire is quick, the answers may be short. We might not learn why students study in certain ways. We need to understand the reasons behind their habits.

Leo: Right. But we can add some open questions. While closed questions are easy to count, open questions give more detail. This way, we can get both numbers and explanations.

Mia: Good point. What about interviews?

Sara: Interviews are useful because we can ask follow-up questions. But they take a lot of time. Because of the time limit, we can only interview a few students. We have only two weeks for the whole project.

Mia: So, maybe we combine both? A short questionnaire for many students, and a few interviews for deeper information. This mixed method could give us a fuller picture.

Leo: I like that. Although it needs more planning, it gives us both width and depth. We can reach many students and still explore their reasons.

Sara: Yes. While the questionnaire gives us numbers, the interviews give us stories. Because we have two weeks, we should start the questionnaire this week. Then we can do the interviews next week.

Mia: OK. Let's decide: questionnaire first, then interviews with five volunteers. Sara, can you prepare the questions?

Sara: Sure. I'll send a draft by Friday. I'll make sure the questions are clear and short.

Leo: And I'll check the questionnaire for clear language. I'll also make sure the questions are not too difficult for students to understand.

Mia: Great. Thanks, everyone. Let's meet again next Monday to review the draft.

grammar.title: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of
grammar.explanation: 主题句概括段落的中心论点，支持句用理由、例子或细节说明它；判断哪句适合作主题句，需要结合实际支持内容。although表示让步（虽然），后接完整从句。while可以表示同时发生（当……时），也可以对比两种情况（而/然而），不能把所有while都解释成让步。because后接完整从句；because of后接名词或名词短语，普通用法不直接接一个限定动词从句。
grammar.example: Although a questionnaire is quick, the answers may be short.

options: Although the weather was cold, we went for a walk.
Although the weather was cold, because we went for a walk.
Although the cold weather, we went for a walk.
Although because the weather was cold, we went for a walk.
answers: Although the weather was cold, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: although 后面接完整句子（the weather was cold），主句也是完整句子。
questions.evidence: Although a questionnaire is quick, the answers may be short.

options: While I was reading, my brother was cooking.
While I was reading, my brother cooking.
While reading I was, my brother was cooking.
While I was reading, because my brother was cooking.
answers: While I was reading, my brother was cooking.
questions.explanation: 这里while表示两个动作同时进行，即“当我读书时，兄弟在做饭”。两边各有主语和有限谓语；不是把此处的while解释成虽然。
questions.evidence: While I was reading, my brother was cooking.

options: Because it was raining, we stayed at home.
Because of it was raining, we stayed at home.
Because the rain, we stayed at home.
Because of raining was, we stayed at home.
answers: Because it was raining, we stayed at home.
questions.explanation: because 后面接完整句子（it was raining）。
questions.evidence: Interviews are useful because we can ask follow-up questions.

options: Because of the heavy traffic, we were late.
Because of the traffic was heavy, we were late.
Because the heavy traffic, we were late.
Because of heavy traffic was, we were late.
answers: Because of the heavy traffic, we were late.
questions.explanation: because of 后面接名词短语（the heavy traffic），不能接句子。
questions.evidence: Because of the time limit, we can only interview a few students.

questions.prompt: Read the support: 'Follow-up questions can reveal reasons, but each interview takes time, so only a small sample is practical.' Which topic sentence best fits this support?
options: Interviews add explanatory detail, but their time cost limits how widely they can be used.
Interviews are mainly valuable because they rapidly produce countable responses from large groups.
Interview planning concerns question wording rather than the number of people who can participate.
Interviews provide broad numerical coverage, while questionnaires explain a few individual cases.
answers: Interviews add explanatory detail, but their time cost limits how widely they can be used.
questions.explanation: 支持内容同时给出访谈的解释深度和时间限制，因此主题句须概括两方面。其他选项把问卷的广覆盖/易计数优势移给访谈，排除了样本限制，或颠倒了两种方法的功能。
questions.evidence: Follow-up questions can reveal reasons, but each interview takes time, so only a small sample is practical.

questions.prompt: Choose the usual neutral clause order for a concession in standard written English.
options: Although she was tired, she finished her homework.
Although she was tired, but she finished her homework.
Although she was tired, because she finished her homework.
Although tired she was, she finished her homework.
answers: Although she was tired, she finished her homework.
questions.explanation: 标准书面让步句用Although + 完整从句，再接主句。although与but通常不在这种结构中并用；此题练习中性语序，其他选项未给出完整、合规的主从结构。
questions.evidence: Although it needs more planning, it gives us both width and depth.

options: While the questionnaire gives us numbers, the interviews give us stories.
While the questionnaire gives us numbers, because the interviews give us stories.
While the questionnaire gives numbers, the interviews stories.
While the questionnaire gives us numbers, the interviews because give us stories.
answers: While the questionnaire gives us numbers, the interviews give us stories.
questions.explanation: while 连接两个完整句子，表示对比。
questions.evidence: While the questionnaire gives us numbers, the interviews give us stories.

options: Because of the rain, the game was cancelled.
Because the rain, the game was cancelled.
Because of it rained, the game was cancelled.
Because of the rain was, the game was cancelled.
answers: Because of the rain, the game was cancelled.
questions.explanation: because of 后接名词短语 the rain。
questions.evidence: Because of the large number of students, a questionnaire is practical.

transfer.writing: Write a method proposal of at least 140 words for a new class project. Explain the question you want to investigate, justify questionnaires, interviews or a combination, and set a feasible time and sample limit. Identify one uncertainty. Use conjunctions where their meanings fit; do not force every connector into the paragraph.
